# Reference

What `vector` declares, generated from its source: the commands and their flags, the JSON files it reads and writes, and the modules it is built from. The guide shows them at work; this lists them all.

## File formats

| Schema | What it describes |
| --- | --- |
| [`program.json`](formats/program.md) |  |
| [`rfc-contract.json`](formats/rfc-contract.md) | What a specification (an RFC, or markdown with numbered headings) requires of a set of functions: verbatim requirements, the functions' signatures, and the clauses (test vectors and properties) that check them. |
| [`spec-plan.json`](formats/spec-plan.md) |  |

## Modules

| Module | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| [`cli/diff`](modules/cli/diff.md) | `vector diff`: prove two programs equivalent, or show where they differ. |
| [`cli/spec-check`](modules/cli/spec-check.md) | `vector spec check`: check a contract's quotes and vectors against its source. |
| [`cli/spec-emit`](modules/cli/spec-emit.md) | `vector spec emit`: emit the Nish test a contract implies. |
| [`cli/spec-exports`](modules/cli/spec-exports.md) | `vector spec exports`: refuse a new export its contract does not cover. |
| [`cli/spec-extract`](modules/cli/spec-extract.md) | `vector spec extract`: extract a contract from a kramdown-rfc spec's XML. |
| [`cli/spec-frozen`](modules/cli/spec-frozen.md) | `vector spec frozen`: refuse a change that edits a frozen contract. |
| [`cli/spec-mutate`](modules/cli/spec-mutate.md) | `vector spec mutate`: mutate the changed lines and refuse mutants the test misses. |
| [`cli/spec-run`](modules/cli/spec-run.md) | `vector spec run`: emit a contract's Nish test and run it. |
| [`cli/spec-stale`](modules/cli/spec-stale.md) | `vector spec stale`: refuse a generated test that no longer matches its contract. |
| [`cli/verify`](modules/cli/verify.md) | `vector verify`: prove a program meets its spec plan. |
| [`core/diag`](modules/core/diag.md) | how vector reports a problem and which exit code it ends with. |
| [`core/fs`](modules/core/fs.md) | paths and directories: join, dirname, a recursive mkdir and fresh temporary directories. |
| [`core/hex`](modules/core/hex.md) | bytes as lowercase hex, and SHA-256. |
| [`core/json`](modules/core/json.md) | reading and writing JSON through `nish/json-value`: parse a file into a document, read typed members with a clear error when one is missing or of the wrong kind, and write a document back with a final newline. |
| [`core/process`](modules/core/process.md) | running a child process with its input given and its output collected. |
| [`core/smt`](modules/core/smt.md) | reading what z3 prints: s-expressions, the numerals in a model, and a whole run's output split into one answer per query by the `(echo "@@Q<i>")` markers the script writes before each `(check-sat)`. |
| [`core/z3`](modules/core/z3.md) | finding z3 and running one SMT-LIB2 script through it. |
| [`main`](modules/main.md) | the command-line entry point. |
